name: departures-board
gates: node -e "const t=require('fs').readFileSync('src/board.js','utf8').replace(/\/\/.*$/gm,''); const bad=(t.match(/#[0-9a-fA-F]{3,8}\b/g)||[]).filter(h=>!['#fff','#ffffff','#000','#000000'].includes(h.toLowerCase())); if(bad.length){console.log('fixed colors in src/board.js: '+bad.join(', ')+' (use the card colors)');process.exit(1)}"
